paper_title: AI Scientists Fail Without Strong Implementation Capability
caption: Analysis of AI Scientist publications on arXiv. The upper panel displays the average number of citations up to now, categorized by containing implementation details. The lower panel shows the growth in the total number of these papers with the same categorization.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the growth in the number of AI Scientist publications on arXiv over three time periods—Fall '24, Winter '24, and Spring '25—categorized by whether they include implementation details. The vertical axis, labeled "Quantity," ranges from 0 to 24, with major gridlines at intervals of 3, and the horizontal axis represents the time periods. Two lines are plotted: a teal solid line with circular markers, labeled "Without Implementation," and an orange solid line with square markers, labeled "With Implementation." The "Without Implementation" line starts at a quantity of 10 in Fall '24, increases to 15 in Winter '24, and reaches 21 in Spring '25. The "With Implementation" line starts at 2 in Fall '24, rises to 7 in Winter '24, and reaches 13 in Spring '25. Both lines show a consistent upward trend, but the "Without Implementation" category consistently has a higher quantity than the "With Implementation" category across all three time points.
